Package com.pulumi.cloud.sdk

Class ResponseWithHeaders<R,​H>

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.pulumi.cloud.sdk.ResponseWithHeaders<R,​H>
  • public final class ResponseWithHeaders<R,​H>
extends java.lang.Object
    Pairs a deserialized response body with typed response headers, mirroring apitype.ResponseWithHeaders[R, H] (Go) / ResponseWithHeaders<R, H> (TypeScript / .NET) / ResponseWithHeaders[R, H] (Python). Returned by generated *Api methods for operations whose response declares response headers.
